requirements.text: Target a local Windows 11 Tauri/Rust host and React/TypeScript renderer; the requested Windows checkout path is configurable deployment context, not source code.
Repository `comzulca/Aster-desktop` is private, with verified owner/collaborator roles and source revision.
Closed catalog selects exact two NVIDIA model IDs; Nemotron is the initial default.
Stream both providers through separately validated adapters and safe text rendering.
Cancel and finish each request exactly once; handle duplicate/out-of-order/framing errors.
Present accurate unconfigured, ready, sending, cancelled, failure and recovery states.
User selects a project root through a native host-controlled dialog; no default root.
Permit bounded UTF-8 project reads solely within a granted and revalidated root.
Present a bounded, typed, exact-diff proposal without giving a model write authority.
After separate exact confirmation, support conflict-checked new-file creation only when native Windows safety/recovery is proven.
Support existing-file replacement only after equivalent native Windows race/crash/recovery proof; otherwise remain proposal-only.
Keep chat state in process memory for the session; clear it on app restart.
Provision/read/delete NVIDIA credential with trusted native Windows UI and host-side Credential Manager calls.
Disable shell, browser, arbitrary network, MCP, and model-provided tool names or URLs in v0.1.0.
Use original 1917×1137 JPG as the dark Aster visual reference, with compact-window adaptation.
Provide keyboard navigation, visible focus, named controls, readable status, safe stream announcements, and Spanish user-facing copy.
Version policy and host state machine so fixed fixtures produce repeatable decisions and exactly one terminal outcome.
Apply time, size, request, stream, file and proposal ceilings and fail closed on exceeded limits.
Bind engineering quality, secret/dependency scans, Windows target tests, SBOM and release claims to an exact revision/artifact.
Credential bytes never pass through renderer/ordinary IPC, logs, repository or model context.
Host authenticates caller and independently validates typed, bounded IPC against a closed window/command permission map.
Live egress allows only fixed NVIDIA HTTPS destination and selected pair; no redirect, unintended proxy, silent retry or fallback.
All file grants bind root identity, conversation, request, resource, operation, expiry and uses; reject aliases and escape attempts.
A model cannot approve a proposal; one human confirmation applies once to one exact change and cannot be replayed.
Publication rechecks root/parent/target identity and old hash, journals intent, verifies outcome, and fails closed on conflict/crash.
Prompt/project contents are disclosed to NVIDIA only by explicit user request; logs redact keys and private content.
No persistent local chat history or unapproved import/export for v0.1.0.
Dependencies, secrets, licenses and release artifacts have independent quality evidence; CI is not a live canary.
Provide an explicit owner-run isolated synthetic native credential GUI diagnostic preserving any existing NVIDIA credential.
Credential diagnostic custody and malformed invocation fail closed before normal host initialization, excluding production credential targets, IPC, providers and network.
Admit the dormant creation journal through retained NTFS pins and creation-time explicit current-process-user private directory/record descriptors.
Revalidate bounded owner/protected owner-only journal DACLs by retained handles before use/success; reject weak/foreign/drifting objects unchanged, without privilege or unrelated ACL changes.
